question: Across 1990-2022, do Coal and Gas emissions move together? (A) Yes, both decline (B) They show no consistent relationship (C) No, coal declines while gas rises. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate stacked_bar chart. All segments are drawn in near-identical blues. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: C (C). Bait: A (A).
